blocks.raw: <Tip>ASD = working stress = elastic = simple. LRFD = factored loads = factored capacity = sophisticated. In ASD, the designer prevents yielding. In LRFD, the designer permits (and expects) yielding but ensures it is controlled and ductile. Load factors > 1 (amplify); resistance factors < 1 (reduce). The product (load factor × resistance factor) is the effective safety margin.</Tip>
